patientReviews.comment: Rented the Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo for a 3-day weekend trip to Desaru Coast via Tuas Second Link. The cross-border VEP and pre-configured RFID sticker breezed through customs in 5 minutes. Outstanding telemetry display and smooth delivery at Changi Terminal 3.

The Ferrari 296 GTB was in pristine concourse condition. The exhaust note in Qualifying mode under the Marina Coastal Expressway (MCE) tunnel was pure theatre. Seamless digital handover at Marina Bay Sands.

Booked the Alphard Executive Lounge with the personal chauffeur package for our board delegates arriving for the Singapore Fintech Festival. The massage seats and chilled beverage compartment were top class.

The contactless NFC digital key unlock worked right from my phone browser at Fusionopolis. Clean, charged to 98%, and ERP 2.0 OBU deduction tracked seamlessly through the app. Way ahead of standard car rental counters.
